structured_data.name: 5 oz Silver Bullet
structured_data.description:
The 5 oz Silver Bullion Bullet (.45 Caliber ACP) is purely decorative and has not been manufactured to be fired from a weapon. Each silver bullet is made from .999 pure silver and weighs one troy ounce. Though you can’t aim and fire this bullet from a gun, you can certainly use it to target some financial and investment goals. Precious silver has long been viewed as a first-rate investment in tangible assets and a great way to diversify your wealth.

We also have 100 Oz Silver Bullet available in our store.
